Middle West Napoleon Calvados Cask-Finished Whiskey is aged five years. The first four years are in American white oak barrels. It is then harvested and enters sunsoaked Calvados casks for another one to two years. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 ml MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 5 years ABV 61.9% (123.8 proof) MASH BILL Dark Pumpernickel Rye Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn 2-row Barley CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak Calvados Casks
